meta.name: playwright-test
meta.description: Run end-to-end browser tests using the Playwright Test CLI. Create test configs, write spec files with expect assertions, execute tests with npx playwright test, and analyze results. Pre-installed with Chromium in the computer image — no setup needed. Use for E2E testing, regression testing, smoke tests, visual comparisons, and automated QA workflows.

copy.tagline: 运行端到端浏览器测试并分析结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你要给网站做自动化测试,不想手动反复点击。
copy.tagline_en: Run end-to-end browser tests and analyze results.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automated website testing without manual clicks.

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求编写或运行浏览器端到端测试时,Claude 会创建 Playwright 配置、编写带断言(expect)的测试脚本、用 npx playwright test 执行并解读结果。预装 Chromium,无需设置。
howto.when: 当用户请求编写或运行 Playwright 测试,或要求进行端到端、回归、冒烟测试等自动化 QA 时触发。

say.text: 给我的应用写一个 Playwright 测试,检查首页标题。
say.note: Claude 会创建配置并编写测试文件。

say.text: 运行 tests 目录下所有测试,并生成 HTML 报告。
用 Playwright 测登录流程,失败时保留截图。
say.note: Claude 会配置 screenshot 并运行测试。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask to write or run browser end-to-end tests, Claude creates Playwright config, writes spec files with expect assertions, runs them via npx playwright test, and analyzes results. Chromium is pre-installed, no setup needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to write or run Playwright tests, or requests end-to-end, regression, or smoke testing, or automated QA workflows.

say_en.text: Write a Playwright test for my app that checks the homepage title.
say_en.note: Claude creates config and test files.

say_en.text: Run all tests in the tests directory and generate an HTML report.
say_en.note: Claude runs npx playwright test and produces a report.

say_en.text: Test the login flow with Playwright, keeping screenshots on failure.
say_en.note: Claude configures screenshots and runs the test.
